description:
Problem: .github/workflows/oracle-review.yml is now a no-op notification. Its permission-less review-event job runs on pull_request_review submitted, edited and dismissed, and the oracle-gate workflow_run bridge (oracle-gate.yml:22-24, workflows: [oracle-verdict, oracle-review]) turns each completion into a gate dispatch. It was kept for one reason: oracle-verdict runs started by a comment, dispatch or schedule carry develop's tip SHA, so their completion cannot be mapped to a PR. Since #3436, oracle-verdict's post job dispatches oracle-gate for the PR and head right after posting the review (oracle-verdict.yml:1000 posts the review, :1010 runs gh workflow run oracle-gate.yml). That post job is the only place oracle reviews are posted. No repository code edits oracle reviews, and GitHub cannot dismiss the oracle's COMMENT reviews. The gate reads oracle reviews, oracle threads, stand-in comments, changed files and the base (oracle_gate.py:136-140); per the Advisor's input analysis it does not read human reviews. So the notification adds no gate input. It still costs a workflow run plus a bridge run per review (62 oracle-review runs in the 2.6 hours after #3429 merged), and it is the one workflow in the gate chain that a pull request controls: GitHub runs the copy in the PR's test merge.

Outcome: oracle-review.yml deleted; the gate bridge subscribes to oracle-verdict only; tests and docs describe the verdict's dispatch as the review-event path.

Decision gates:
1. Evidence window (enforced by not_before). For every oracle-verdict run since e2fa1f80e merged (2026-10-25T05:38Z) whose post job posted a review: the dispatch step concluded success, and an oracle-gate workflow_dispatch run for that PR and head started after it. Record the counts and run IDs. A missed or failed dispatch stops this item: file a defect for the dispatch path and make this item need it.
2. Load-bearing check. For each oracle-gate run that the bridge started from an oracle-review completion in the window, find a dispatch-started gate run for the same PR and head at or before it. If any bridge run had no matching dispatch and changed the posted oracle-gate state, the notification carried a real input: stop and record which one.
3. Same-head flip. Record at least one same-head success-to-non-success oracle review followed, via the dispatch path, by an oracle-gate failure newer than the review. If none happens naturally, record 'not observed'; never manufacture verdicts or reviews to produce one.
4. Re-verify the gate's inputs at implementation time (oracle_gate.py decide call and _project/scripts/oracle_review_check.py). If the gate reads any review event that oracle-verdict does not post, such as human reviews or review edits, stop: the notification is still needed.
5. Keep the bridge's oracle-verdict entry. Removing it is out of scope.

Scope:
- Delete .github/workflows/oracle-review.yml and tests/unit/workflows/test_oracle_review_workflow.py.
- .github/workflows/oracle-gate.yml: workflows: [oracle-verdict]; remove any bridge logic specific to oracle-review completions.
- Update tests that load the file: test_oracle_gate_workflow.py:119, test_oracle_verdict_workflow.py:17 and 62-67 (keep the :349 assertion), test_release_pr_check_scope.py:29.
- Keep the .github/workflows/oracle-review.yml entries in .github/soundness-paths.txt:89 and .github/oracle-reviewers.yml:96, so a re-created file is still soundness-reviewed. If a manifest check requires listed files to exist (see tests/unit/scripts/test_soundness_paths.py:67), use the manifest's pattern form rather than dropping coverage.
- Remove oracle_review_check.py code used only by the retired checker, after confirming with LSP references that oracle_gate.py and soundness_merge_digest.py do not call it.
- Docs: docs/internal/oracle-review-v2.md (notification section near :617), docs/internal/repo-admin-settings.md:70-71, docs/internal/soundness-drain.md:39, docs/internal/dev-loop-property-ledger.md:84 and :120; supersede the 'keeps its path and name' clause in _project/decisions/oracle-review-check-retired-2026-10-24.md.
- Leave unchanged: tests that use 'oracle-review' only as a sample check name (test_check_suites.py, test_pr_rerun.py, test_pr_landing.py, test_remote_closeout.py, test_pr_arm.py, the ruleset tests); comment-policy tests that reject oracle-review as evidence; soundness_merge_digest.py's 'oracle-review' signal, which is derived from oracle reviews, not this workflow, and its ORACLE_PATH test fixture.

Item guardrails: do not change oracle-verdict's posting or dispatch steps, the oracle_gate.py decision, the sweep or stand-in handling. Do not ask the owner to disable the workflow in repository settings: deleting the file stops runs on every PR whose test merge includes develop. A PR whose test merge cannot be computed keeps its old copy, which is harmless because nothing requires or reads it.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no stand-in approvals, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Do not change oracle-gate's App binding (integration 5201041), the oracle decision rule, or the native review-thread-resolution requirement. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests.
